status: mechanical schema/geometry validated; no visual review performed

canvas.coordinateConvention: x/y fractions of256 canvas; source128 normalized rig mapped into256 units only; no raster scaling; ARM=wrist, LEG=ankle

provenance.appearanceSource: Matching clean approved R8 directional idle only

retargeting.rootMethod: Old NECK relative to six-frame mean -> R8 NECK. Preserve source vertical bob and scale horizontal sway by projected shoulder-axis ratio.

axisRatioMethod.shoulder: signed projected x span (proven South method)
axisRatioMethod.hip: signed projected x span (proven South method)

retargeting.pelvisMethod: Preserve hip-center sway relative to neck around R8 hip center, scaled hip spread and torso height.
retargeting.limbMethod: Copy old projected bone vectors scaled by R8 reference / mean old projected bone length. Pooled bilateral legs avoid estimator side bias. No mirrored or inserted poses.
retargeting.headMethod: Translate the unchanged matching R8 five head-landmark offsets as a rigid group with neck bob/sway. Keep each reference landmark's z-index.
retargeting.rearViewSafeguard: Head labels are virtual rig landmarks on a rear view, not a request for visible facial features. Keep R8 rear/quarter-rear appearance; never invent a frontal face, eyes, or glasses.
retargeting.depthMethod: Omit explicit depth; direction-matched mannequin template supplies depth. Source-estimator limb/body z_index retained.
retargeting.hiddenJointReview: Robe-occluded hips/knees reuse source estimates; no art or visual rig review performed.
retargeting.seamNote: Exact original0..5 order and5->0 seam retained; no smoothing poses.
retargeting.geometryLimits: Skeleton controls pose; root shows generated results directly for user feedback. Mechanical checks only.
